items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Well, they'd hire me on banjo and hire Howard on banjo. Well, at that end of the band, they put Howard over there. And at this end of the band, they put me over here.

ctx.x: Oh, you're tired, you're tired. Oh, no, no, no, no, I'm trying to keep quiet to let you talk.

I had that coffee then. You know, uh... Kid Howard, Chester Jones, so many others. Those people would have their churches. My mother had her church, too. And my mother used to ask Caps, she'd say, why don't you all come down and play at my church sometime? And, uh, we'd go down there and play. And my mother would say, uh, I'm glad you all came. She said, I'm gonna have dinner for you. She said, I have a wonderful dinner back there. I'd get my teacher out of Howard and Howard said, I haven't eaten yet. And, uh,…
And then, uh, you know, you wanna come back down here and eat?
